name: @examples/rn-brownfield
description: React Native brownfield example: rn-app/ is packaged as an AAR and an XCFramework that the native android-app/ and ios-app/ host apps embed.

scripts.demo:android: pnpm --filter @examples/rn-brownfield-rn-app publish-local:aar && pnpm --filter @examples/rn-brownfield-android-app build && pnpm --filter @examples/rn-brownfield-android-app android
scripts.demo:ios: pnpm --filter @examples/rn-brownfield-rn-app package:ios && pnpm --filter @examples/rn-brownfield-ios-app frameworks && pnpm --filter @examples/rn-brownfield-ios-app ios
